semantic_content.answer: There are 7 such subsets. One example is {1,8}. Exhaustively: a subset summing to 9 has size 2 or 3, since no singleton is available and four distinct positive elements sum to at least 1+2+3+4=10. The 2-element subsets are {1,8}, {2,7}, {3,6}, {4,5}; the 3-element subsets are {1,2,6}, {1,3,5}, {2,3,4}. Thus the total is 4+3=7.
